metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.2 · 1996 · Mission: Impossible
metas.description: An American agent, under false suspicion of disloyalty, must discover and expose the real spy without the help of his organization.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.1 · 2000 · Mission: Impossible II
metas.description: IMF agent Ethan Hunt is sent to Sydney to find and destroy a genetically modified disease called "Chimera".

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.9 · 2006 · Mission: Impossible III
metas.description: IMF agent Ethan Hunt comes into conflict with a dangerous and sadistic arms dealer who threatens his life and his fiancée in response.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 7.4 · 2011 · Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol
metas.description: The IMF is shut down when it's implicated in the bombing of the Kremlin, causing Ethan Hunt and his new team to go rogue to clear their organization's name.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 7.4 · 2015 · Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation
metas.description: Ethan and his team take on their most impossible mission yet when they have to eradicate an international rogue organization as highly skilled as they are and committed to destroying the IMF.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 7.7 · 2018 · Mission: Impossible - Fallout
metas.description: A group of terrorists plans to detonate three plutonium cores for a simultaneous nuclear attack on different cities. Ethan Hunt, along with his IMF team, sets out to stop the carnage.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 7.6 · 2023 · Mission: Impossible - Dead Reckoning Part One
metas.description: Ethan Hunt and his IMF team must track down a terrifying new weapon that threatens all of humanity.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 7.1 · 2025 · Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
metas.description: Hunt and the IMF pursue a dangerous AI called the Entity that's infiltrated global intelligence. With governments and a figure from his past in pursuit, Hunt races to stop it from forever changing the world.
